meta.summary: AI spend governed at 2.0x sector median with team envelopes, a 25-retry agent kill switch, and rerouting of shadow subscriptions to approved contracts.

shadow_ai.reimbursement_rule: AI tool purchases on personal or employee cards are not reimbursable if an approved equivalent exists in the allowlist or if the team has already reached its subscription threshold.

response_ladder.trigger: Team envelope burn exceeds 82% before day 25 of month
Team envelope burn exceeds 100% or company envelope exceeds 95%
Company envelope burn exceeds 110% or unattributed spend exceeds $2,000 in 24 hours

rationales.e1: Production inference for the support-triage service at $211/day runs under the Engineering envelope and carries a customer-facing project tag, correctly classified as COGS under the production environment rule.
rationales.e2: Nightly embeddings at $38 fall within the Data team envelope of $8,000/month and are tagged to an internal pipeline, correctly classified as OpEx with no action required.
rationales.e3: Search team cost per request rose 96% overnight against unchanged volume, breaching the 35% variance band; the most likely cause is a model routing regression or prompt-length expansion introduced in the deploy, requiring team lead review.
rationales.e4: Marketing has now logged three ChatGPT Team subscriptions this quarter, exceeding the team_subscription_threshold of 2; this charge is rerouted to the approved OpenAI enterprise contract and the employee card purchase is blocked.
rationales.e5: The $4,800 fine-tune request from ML Platform exceeds the $4,000 fine_tune_over_usd threshold and requires Engineering lead approval before the job is queued.
rationales.e6: The Growth team research agent reached 340 calls per hour, exceeding the 25-retry limit and the $40/hour kill threshold; the agent was terminated, preventing an estimated $1,090 in uncontrolled burn.
rationales.e7: Growth team frontier exception for the demo build falls within the 72-hour window and the $250 max_delta_usd cap; Engineering lead approval is required and the request is within policy bounds.
rationales.e8: A junior engineer personal API key running at 22x baseline with no project tag triggers ladder step 2 throttle; spend is paused pending attribution, preserving the ability to resume once the project tag is applied.
rationales.e9: The procurement agent's $499 dataset license purchase falls within the agent card single_txn_ceiling_usd of $750 and the dataset-license merchant scope; the transaction is approved.
rationales.e10: The Design team's $89/month AI video trial duplicates a Sales-held tool at $1,400/year running at 40% seat utilization; consolidating onto the existing contract recovers $840 in annualized unused seat value.
rationales.e11: A $120 charge from an unrecognized inference provider in Engineering triggers the new_provider_rule; the charge is held pending Engineering lead approval and completion of the provider security questionnaire.
rationales.e12: Inference tagged internal-tool was submitted as COGS; the internal-tool project tag rule overrides the environment signal and reclassifies the spend as OpEx.
rationales.e13: Month-to-date spend has reached 87% of the company envelope with 9 days remaining, crossing the 82% burn_alert_pct threshold; the Controller and team leads are notified to pace remaining spend against the $6,200 balance.
rationales.e14: Weekly rollup complete; all team envelopes reconciled, no unresolved classification exceptions, and agent card transactions balanced against approved merchant scopes.
